subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw support session-scoped channel switching between configured agents, and what command, authorization, and state contract should own it given the existing `/agents` subagent command?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the permanent behavior crosses channel command UX, route resolution, session state, workspace isolation, tool policy, credentials, and existing command namespace semantics.

options.title: Design Guarded Session Switch
options.body: Add a shared session-scoped active-agent override with authorized configured-agent listing, explicit clear behavior, canonical storage, and non-conflicting command semantics.

options.title: Keep Static Channel Routing
options.body: Decline direct configured-agent switching in channels and keep bindings, `/focus`, TUI switching, and Gateway RPC/UI selection as the supported multi-agent paths.

options.title: Expose Plugin/Command Seam First
options.body: Design a generic SDK or typed command action seam so channel plugins can implement visible switching only after the core policy contract exists.

recommendation.title: Design Guarded Session Switch
recommendation.body: Add a shared session-scoped active-agent override with authorized configured-agent listing, explicit clear behavior, canonical storage, and non-conflicting command semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal on the multi-agent routing and native command target contracts this decision would change.
